title: 📊 Daily Report: Fri Oct 30, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $18,558.93, down $48.21 on the day (-0.26%) in a rough tape where the Nasdaq 100 fell about 4%. For the week it's down $618.36 against Monday's base: the strategy bots lost $134.55 and the CORE QQQ sleeve lost $483.81.

Since the merge, the book is down 7.30% (-$1,461.81) while Indy, the SPY hold benchmark, is down 2.93% (-$587.64), so we trail SPY by $874.17. Indy finished today at $19,435.04.

Trek was the only bot that traded today. It bought 2 USO and 2 COP on 15-day breakouts, funded by two small CORE QQQ trims. CORE QQQ holds about $17,048 (92% of the book), and its trend filter is still on (prior close 715.34 vs the 200-day at 678.01). Trek, Rota, and Sunny are active; everyone else is benched. Open risk is $114 across 5 positions.

Weekly rule: this week did not pass. The strategies finished $134.55 below Monday's base, the third losing week in a row.

Research's note for today: AI-spending fears hit hard, with the Nasdaq 100 down about 4% and the S&P 500 down about 2.5%, and Intel dropping about 29% on a weak outlook. Energy (CVX +1.8%, XOM +2.2%) worked as the hedge, and avoiding chips kept the desk out of the worst of it. Next week brings Apple and Palantir on Monday, AMD and the midterms on Tuesday, and the October jobs report on Friday. Research's weekly hit rate was 8 of 17 swing calls up, averaging +0.1% each versus SPY down about 1%. (Research)

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/
